verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a terminal AI coding agent, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics, or any opt-out setting. The 'usage' field in headless JSON output refers to run results, not telemetry, and local SQLite storage is a different feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
